scope: Recording-relative future descriptor prediction; no verified live onset, perceptual quality, physical bow-force or new-algorithm claim

data.thresholds: recording-weighted linear .25/.5/.75 quantiles of valid training targets only
data.target_guard: at least 50% and at least two voiced target frames; invalid retained as all-false nine rules
data.deduplication: within-person exact PCM aliases; any cross-person full/prefix PCM copy blocks

models.training_weights: equal total weight per training participant
models.preprocessing: StandardScaler fit on training X only; clip standardized values to [-8,8]; no tuning or early stopping
models.neural_objective: same nine-rule marginal BCE; plain joint versus Markov-log-prior-offset is the removal comparison
models.auxiliary_untrained_baseline: prefix-rule persistence with the same probability clipping; does not consume a training job

evaluation.primary: participant-macro mean of nine-rule log loss, clip 1e-6
evaluation.seed_aggregation: mean per-participant loss across all three seeds; ensemble probability score is optional and separate
evaluation.simple_baseline_selection: lowest participant-macro dev log loss among frequency, markov, hgb; ties in that order; sealed before opening test labels
evaluation.test: open test labels once after all twelve predictions and dev comparator selection are sealed
evaluation.uncertainty: paired participant bootstrap, 5000 resamples, seed20261102, no row/seed pseudo-replication
evaluation.claims: 2% is an exploratory operational screen; superiority requires compatible uncertainty evidence and is not guaranteed

budget.failure_policy: record failure and stop; no replacement seed or silent retry

novelty: Conventional conditional prior offsets, joint finite-pattern probabilities, CDFs and coherence are not new methods. This bounded study tests application feasibility and mechanism benefit. No hyperparameter search follows a negative result.
